_source: CORE Math Pacing Guide Grade 1 - Open Up Resources with Open Up (OUR Math), uploaded 8/30/26, transcribed by week. Same segment-list schema as Grade K's our_math_gK_weeks.json.
_note: Module = Unit (OUR Math's own numbering), Unit = Section (hyphenated when a week spans multiple sections within the same Unit, e.g. 'A-B'). Guide typo: the header table for weeks 3-4, 5, 10, 16, 21, 24, 28, 32 consistently undercounts the outgoing section/unit's last lesson in its own header row (e.g. week 3's header says 'Lessons 7-9' but the week's own lesson list runs through Lesson 10) - resolved in favor of the week's own lesson-by-lesson content, confirmed against Appendix A's Grade 1 OUR Math bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md, which independently include the same 'missing' lesson in its own title list. A second guide typo: Lesson 13's Teacher Resources link (week 8) points to lesson-12; the Student Resources link and the lesson title both confirm it is Lesson 13, transcribed as such. Week 34's checkpoint is literally labelled 'Section C Checklist' in the guide (all seven other checkpoints in this file say 'Checkpoint') - transcribed as printed, not normalized. Course finishes at week 35 (Unit 8 Assessments & Review); week 36 in the guide is a generic 'Review' page with two open-ended activities not tied to any Unit/Section/Lesson, matching no M|U|L content at all, so it carries no key here - same shape as a curriculum finishing before week 36 elsewhere in this project. Confirmed against Appendix A: LP1-3 and LP9-10 verified line-for-line (lesson lists, checkpoint placement, and the Unit 8 Assessments/Review-only LP10 ending all match); LP4-8 spot-checked and consistent.
